newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT -T-bonds to struggle with 111-23 barrier.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT -T-bonds to struggle with 111-23 barrier.

text.p: September T-bond futures will have difficulty surmounting resistance nearby at 111-23 on Monday, technical analysts said.

"We did see a technical rally coming in on Friday but it got stuck at 111-23," Anne Whitby, head of technical analysis at 4CAST in London said. "That's quite a nasty band of resistance and it will have trouble with it."
The contract hit a high of 111-23 on Friday and Thursday, after sliding down from higher levels earlier in the week.
T-bonds were quoted at 111-20 at 0912 GMT, unchanged in automated trade from the CBOT pit settlement.
"If it did clear it you'd probably be looking for a recovery towards 112-00, which is congestion over quite a period of days," Whitby said.
Support this session would come in at the overnight low of 111-18, followed by 111-16 congestion on Friday, she said.

"A break there would confirm the strength of the selling overhead and would lead to a test of 111-08 which was quite an active buying area on Friday," she said. "If that breaks we're back to 111-02 again which is Friday's low," she said.
Analysts at a European bank in London also put support around 111-00.
Further down, a buffer arrives at around 110-00 this session, a trendline drawn from the April 28 low, they said.
"If 111-00 breaks, then it'll take a while longer to push through June's 112-24 high, implying a more drawn out consolidation," they said in a note.
December Eurodollars were trading on SIMEX at 93.955 at 0943 GMT, up 0.005 from the Chicago settlement.
